reason: Value/transfer lens: the gate change adds essentially no expected value, and one of its three arms is mis-specified. (1) The ceiling arithmetic is correct: adj = J*(1-0.1*(Tp-Tt)/Tt) (tools/official/metrics.md l.40-49) is linear, so +1% nodes costs ~-0.00095 and +0.3% costs ~-0.00029. But the cost is linear in both directions. A node DECREASE is a multiplier gain, so a symmetric +-0.3% gate also rejects beneficial decreases. (2) The old LB evidence does not support 'node drift is the left tail'. Probes 12/16 were Z-flip views in the EDGE-feature TTA loops, not detection-map averaging (RESULTS.md l.45, l.48). exp31 had +7% nodes (CONTEXT l.894), which predicts -0.0066 from the multiplier alone, but the observed result was -0.003. exp34 was -0.009 with no documented node growth. Probe 19 (axis-flip, raw nodes flat) still tied at -0.001 after +0.021 local (l.52). So non-transfer happens with flat nodes, and node neutrality is not what makes a view-averaging change transfer. (3) The per-frame top-K guard is not new. It is already FIX (1) in wf_ideas_v3/v_literature_symmetric-temporal-det-fusion_schedule.json. The +-0.3% per-clip final-node gate already exists in tools/dummy_gates.py l.119-120 for K2 vs K1. The only new element is the readmit/gapfill +-10% arm. (4) That arm kills the mechanism when it works. Tempfuse targets cells that are faint in one frame and visible in the neighbour. Today exactly those cells are recovered downstream by readmit (lowdet pool, MIN_SCORE 0.965) and gapfill. A working tempfuse moves them into the detection stage, so readmit and gapfill counts fall by more than 10% while final nodes stay flat. The gate would reject the success mode. It is also small-count noise: the 4 dummy clips hold 1,365 readmits and 111 gapfill nodes in total (CONTEXT l.1817-1823), so +-10% of gapfill is a few nodes per clip. (5) The size cannot be measured. The claimed +0.0002 (E[K4] +0.0003 -> +0.0005) is 1/15 of the 2-run LB SD (~0.003). K4 itself is optional and cut first under R10 (+0.0008 central, P(>= +0.002) 0.10-0.15 per the v3 value review), and it must be scored before the R8 cut-off. Private transfer: the multiplier term is the same on private, so there is no embryo-specific artefact, but there is also no gain to transfer.
fix: If K4 is built: (a) make node neutrality hold by construction. Clamp the per-frame top-K to exactly K (0 tolerance, where K = pos-1 peaks >= 0.965 in that frame) instead of +-max(1,1%). (b) Make the final-node gate one-sided: per clip <= +0.3% vs the F1-stack dummy, with decreases allowed. (c) Do NOT gate on readmit/gapfill +-10%. Report them, and gate on detected+readmitted combined within +-0.3%, plus no 'REPAIR FAILED'/'DEADLINE'. Also log the per-frame peak-set IoU (expect 1-10% changed) to confirm tempfuse actually did something. Editing the pre-registration (0.3 h) is fine, but it should not be counted as a gain line.
realistic_gain: ~0 incremental (0 to +0.0002 public and private). Unmeasurable against the ~0.003 LB SD. As written, the +-10% readmit/gapfill arm has a small negative option value, because it would most likely veto a tempfuse that works (worth ~+0.0008 central).
